title: Using machine learning approaches to classify false-positives generated by static analysis tools - An empirical study using small datasets
abstract: arXiv:2611.19079v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Static Code Analysis (SCA) tools are vital for software development to reduce the cost and time required for manual code reviews. It was established in our previous study that the best tools reported in the software engineering community return high false-positive and false-negative rates when used for code analysis. Several approaches have been taken in existing studies to identify false-positive alarms generated by SCA tools, in helping to enhance the utility of these tools. However, existing studies reveal several limitations, chiefly among which is the tendency to focus on a limited number of alarm types or failing to evaluate a large breadth of Machine-Learning (ML) techniques comprehensively. This study has addressed this opportunity. We identified the best Code Representation Learning (CRL) techniques and ML algorithms for identifying false-positives, where results show that performance outcomes vary based on the characteristics

translated_title: 使用机器学习方法对静态分析工具产生的误报进行分类——一项基于小数据集的实证研究
translated_abstract: 静态代码分析（SCA）工具对于软件开发至关重要，能够降低人工代码审查所需的成本和时间。我们在先前的研究中已经证实，软件工程界所报道的最佳工具在用于代码分析时会返回较高的误报率和漏报率。现有研究已采取多种方法来识别SCA工具产生的误报警告，以帮助提升这些工具的实用性。然而，现有研究存在若干局限性，其中最主要的是倾向于只关注数量有限的警报类型，或者未能全面评估广泛的机器学习（ML）技术。本研究针对这一机遇展开。我们确定了用于识别误报的最佳代码表示学习（CRL）技术和机器学习算法，结果表明其性能表现会根据特征的不同而有所变化。
tldr: 本研究在小数据集条件下系统评估了多种代码表示学习技术与机器学习算法来识别静态分析工具的误报，弥补了以往研究仅关注少量警报类型或评估不全面的不足，并发现最佳方法的选择取决于数据特征。
